craft_notes: Sthāyin: vismaya at sundered-varied shine — stain and shine in one breath throughout. Cut-cut doubled (killed twice); when left open (effort-when open per INF). Rejected: (a) single cut → killed: doubling is the cutting. (b) closing the when → killed by INF. Read aloud: KNOW-ing-MEANS, MIND, HORDES … WHEN.

lines: that, cut, cut — doing, knowing, striving — when.
